title: Our Future Health — Linked health records data — Deaths — warning checks
description: Non-blocking checks for the nhse_engwal_deaths table, from rules the source does not state but the steward asked to have checked (D122). A finding is a warning for analysts and data providers: it never rejects a row and never changes data. Run tools/warn.py; the main schema and tools/validate.py are unaffected.
